reflection: Where did your attention go during the silence? List the places. Which one did it return to most often?

When have you recognised, or felt, God's help in your life? If you cannot identify such a time, say so honestly. Your inability to recall an experience does not make the psalm's declaration untrue, and Session Seven will return to this.
The disciples were afraid because the boat was filling. What reasonable fear makes it difficult for you to remember or trust that Christ remains with you?
Finish this sentence: "If I gave this present moment my attention without trying to solve the past or anticipate the future, I would notice…"
